ideas.title: Following the Money in Child Care Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the financial trail of child care fraud in Minnesota, including the use of fake autism therapy and empty stomachs
questions: How did the alleged perpetrators launder the money?
ideas.insight: I believe that following the money will reveal a complex web of financial transactions and potentially identify additional perpetrators. This story has the potential to expose a large-scale fraud scheme and hold those responsible accountable.
